input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a comma-separated file describing the samples.
input.help_text: Requires the columns `sample` and `fastq_1`. `fastq_2` may be empty for single-end samples. Optional `replicate` and `condition` columns are carried through for downstream analysis.

reads.description: Legacy input: a quoted glob matching FASTQ file pairs, e.g. 'data/*_R{1,2}.fq.gz'.
reads.help_text: Retained for backwards compatibility with the DSL1 pipeline. Prefer --input, which also carries replicate and condition metadata.

single_end.description: Treat --reads input as single-end. Ignored when --input is used, where it is decided per sample.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to the output directory.

save_trimmed.description: Publish the trimmed FASTQ files. They are large and rarely needed.

fasta.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA. Required unless --aligner_index or --genome supplies one.

genome.description: AWS iGenomes preset, supplying the FASTA, bwa index, GTF, blacklist, mitochondrial contig name and MACS genome size.
genome.help_text: Presets live in conf/igenomes.config and resolve to s3://ngi-igenomes paths. Each genome is paired with a blacklist whose contig naming matches its own FASTA (UCSC/NCBI builds use chr1, Ensembl builds use 1), so the two can never be mismatched by the preset. Any derived value can be overridden individually. Requires --read_length, because MACS genome size is stored per read length.

read_length.description: Read length, used to select the MACS/effective genome size for a --genome preset.

mito_name.description: Mitochondrial contig name. Defaults to the genome preset, or chrM. Excluded from library-complexity metrics and reported separately in the FRiP table.

igenomes_ignore.description: Ignore the genome presets entirely, so no reference is ever resolved from S3. Use for offline or air-gapped runs, supplying --fasta and --blacklist yourself.

species.description: Deprecated alias for --genome, kept for backwards compatibility.

aligner.description: Read aligner. bwa-mem2 is faster but needs substantially more RAM to build its index.

aligner_index.description: Directory containing a pre-built index for the selected aligner. Skips indexing, and makes --fasta optional. Must match --aligner: bwa and bwa-mem2 index formats are not interchangeable.

blacklist.description: BED file of blacklisted regions. Overrides the genome preset. Must use the same contig naming as the reference (UCSC chr1 vs Ensembl 1) or filtering silently does nothing; the pipeline now checks this at runtime.

macs_gsize.description: MACS effective genome size ('mm', 'hs', or a number). Overrides the genome preset.

effective_genome_size.description: Effective genome size used for RPGC normalisation of bigwigs. Overrides the genome preset.

trim.description: Run trimmomatic. When false the reads go straight to alignment.

adapter.description: Adapter set: 'atac'/'nextera', 'truseq', or a path to an adapter FASTA.

macs_qvalue.description: MACS q-value (FDR) cutoff for narrow and broad peak calling.

macs_format.description: BED treats each read end as an independent Tn5 insertion; BAMPE calls on whole fragments.

hmmratac.description: Additionally call peaks with MACS3 hmmratac.

downstream_analysis_options.title: Downstream analysis options
downstream_analysis_options.description: Cross-sample analysis over the consensus peak set.

gtf.description: GTF annotation. Enables TSS enrichment and nearest-gene peak annotation.

tss_window.description: Base pairs either side of the TSS in the enrichment profile.

tss_bin_size.description: Bin size for the TSS enrichment profile.

deseq2_fdr.description: FDR threshold reported for differential accessibility.

skip_consensus.description: Skip consensus peaks, the counts matrix, DESeq2 and peak annotation.

skip_tss_enrichment.description: Skip the TSS enrichment profile only.

resource_options.title: Resource options
resource_options.description: Ceilings applied to every process request.

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPUs any single task may request. Defaults to the detected core count.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory any single task may request.

max_time.description: Maximum time any single task may request.

slurm_account.description: SLURM account, passed as --account (used by -profile slurm).

slurm_qos.description: SLURM QOS, passed as --qos (used by -profile slurm).

shift.description: Perl script used for Tn5 offset correction.
